task.title: OODA E2E #6: telemetry → Incident → Postmortem → EvolutionDecisionProposal test
task.summary_zh: OODA Learn 階段：證明「paper run telemetry → IncidentCase → Postmortem → EvolutionDecisionProposal」transition 可端到端走完。注入 1 條合成 incident-trigger telemetry，跑 POST-EVO-BRIDGE。獨立 test 檔，無 live mutation。
acceptance: test injects fixture telemetry event with severity=high into ingest endpoint
asserts IncidentCase record created with related runtime_binding_id and artifact_id
test triggers Postmortem creation referencing the incident
asserts POST-EVO-BRIDGE emits EvolutionDecisionProposal with proposed_action in (rollback freeze retrain)
asserts bridge does NOT write to governance store and no live runtime mutation occurs
task.next: Owner finalized: 8 e2e tests pass (pytest -q -x, 0.96s), PR #72 merged into dev, proposal-only invariants verified, bridge governance-clean. Task artifacts committed in 40500d7f.
review_notes_zh: 審查通過：8 個 e2e tests 全部 pass (pytest -q -x 0.79s)。所有接受標準逐一驗證：fixture severity=high + deployment_stage=paper + 全部 binding/lineage 欄位齊全；IncidentCase 正確攜帶 runtime_binding_id / artifact_id；Postmortem 透過 IncidentStore 正確連結 incident lineage；POST-EVO-BRIDGE 回傳 proposal dict 且 proposed_action=rollback (severity=high 映射正確)；governance_store_written 缺席/False；created_by_role=evolution_controller；無 live mutation。bridge 程式碼路徑確認無 governance store 寫入。
後續：OODA-E2E-007 full packet closure 依賴此 task done。
